questions.enonce_markdown: State the function of human skeleton. *(5 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The human skeleton has the following functions:

1. **Support:** it holds up the body, giving it shape and posture.
2. **Protection:** it protects delicate organs - the skull protects the brain, the rib cage protects the heart and lungs, the vertebral column protects the spinal cord.
3. **Movement:** bones act as **levers** and provide attachment for muscles through tendons; at the joints, contraction of muscles moves the bones.
4. **Production of blood cells:** red and white blood cells are made in the **bone marrow**.
5. **Storage of minerals:** bones store calcium and phosphorus salts, released into the blood when needed.
6. **Breathing:** the ribs and sternum move to change the volume of the thorax (additional point).

questions.enonce_markdown: Make a labelled diagram of a typical synovial joint. *(5 marks)*

questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) **Long-sightedness (hypermetropia)** is an eye defect in which a person can **see distant objects clearly but not near objects**. The eyeball is too short (or the lens too weak), so light from a near object is focused **behind the retina**. It is corrected by wearing **converging (convex) lenses**.

(ii) **Astigmatism** is an eye defect caused by an **uneven curvature of the cornea or of the lens** (shaped more like a rugby ball than a sphere). Light rays in different planes are focused at different points, so the image is **blurred or distorted**, for example vertical lines are clear while horizontal lines are not. It is corrected by wearing **cylindrical lenses**.
